article.headline: Oman confirms active US–Iran back-channel talks in Muscat

assignments.reason: Oman (a classic Gulf intermediary) confirming it is hosting US–Iran back-channel talks is a direct signal of active third-party mediation.

Back-channel talks indicate engagement is alive (ruling out breakdown) but their indirect, behind-the-scenes nature signals no concluded deal yet, consistent with a stalled-but-ongoing track rather than success.
Confirmed active dialogue channels keep a diplomatic off-ramp available.

recorded_response.overall_rationale: Oman-hosted back-channel talks confirm active mediation and a still-open diplomatic path, with negotiations engaged but not yet producing a breakthrough.
